about.title: About
about.subtitle: Software engineer, writing about what I learn as I learn it.
about.contact: Found something wrong, or want to compare notes?
about.contactHint: Telegram is the fastest way to reach me.
about.nowText: Reading and building to fill in the layers I skipped — from the code I write down to the machines it runs on.

bio.p1: I'm a software engineer. Most of my working hours go into a transport management system: software that moves freight between places and punishes you for every detail you get wrong.
bio.p2: Outside of work I go looking for the parts I skipped — how the layers underneath my code actually behave, why the abstractions are shaped the way they are, and what changes once you stop treating any of it as a black box.
bio.p3: This is where I keep those notes. Some of them will be wrong. I leave the corrections in rather than quietly tidying them away, because writing things down is the only reliable way I've found to discover what I don't actually understand.
